game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Ice Market, a market under icicles: the snow ranger must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Keyword Switchboard: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Market: a market under icicles
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Market, repeat each round: Call functions with keyword arguments to wire the right switches. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the wires value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the hold gate using at most 15 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The hold gate reached with actions_used <= 15.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 15 before the hold gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 3 (intro tier): Keyword Switchboard
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Keyword Switchboard' (Week 6 slot 12), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ice Market'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how wires changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Ice Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The hold gate reached with actions_used <= 15.
